name: Giansun Precision Technology Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Giansun Precision Technology Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, design, production, and sale of aluminum extrusion dies and accessories, aluminum extrusion supporting equipment, precision machinery parts, and other products. Its products are used in building decoration, transportation, new energy, automotive light weighting, consumer electronics, aerospace, and other fields. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Jiangyin, China.
